    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BlackjackGame
    The BlackjackGame is where the mechanics of the game is played.
    Deal
    The Deal Class extends the Deck class This class creates the 52 card deck that the game will be played with As well as deal out cards at random
    Dealer
    The Dealer class is a subclass of Player It shares similar methods: uses the same logic with super in Dealer's method The Dealer method shares none of the private Bank class variables or methods as a dealer can not bet
    Deck
    The Deck class holds the values of the cards in the deck(CARD_DECK) Each array row starts with the suit and then the following card values
    HandEvaluator
    The HandEvaluator class determines the card's number value of a hand If there is an Ace it stores the default value 11 to then be set by the Player as needed; into a hashmap If it is a T(10) J(Jack) Q(Queen) K(King) the value of 10 will be added to an ArrayList If neither the numeric value of the character of the value 2-9 is added to the ArrayList In addition, the class also determines if the value of the hand is greater than 21 leading to a bust
    Hit
    The Hit interface holds the methods that will need to be used when cards are being given to the player or the dealer
    Main
    This class is the Main class of Blackjack.java Its purpose is to run a BlackjackGame and catch any errors that may occur during the program Example: The single deck running out of cards(Empty Array)
    Player
    The Player class creates the player objects allowing it to take certain actions with the player's hand As its constructors it takes a name, initial betting amount(betAmount) and a Deal object Within the class is a private inner class Bank which stores the betting amount the player has and handles wins/losses/pushes keeping it to just the Player object The class implements both Hit and Stay, and creates both for their abstract methods excluding the Hit's getCard method which is a default method of the interface
    Stay
    The interface Stay holds the methods needed for the action of when the dealer or player needs to stay their hand
